formula: For each half: q = logistic(logit((pitcher_zero+20*league_zero_rate)/(pitcher_n+20)) + logit((offense_zero+20*league_zero_rate)/(offense_n+20)) - logit(league_zero_rate)); p_NRFI=q_top*q_bottom
league_prior: Beta(1,1) updated with strictly earlier same-season half innings
history: same season; exact MLBAM pitcher and stored team identity; score entire calendar date before updating histories
side_rule: NRFI if p>=0.75, YRFI if p<=0.25, otherwise abstain
external: Not opened unless development gates pass; freeze first, then genuinely future unobserved games with preserved pregame starter identity and source lineage
tuning: No parameter grid, no threshold search, no retuning after result
